mode_auto_help: Your logo if you have one, otherwise a monogram: your initials, in your heading font and your theme's colours. It changes along with your theme.
mode_image_help: An image from your media library, cropped to a square.
mode_kit_help: You draw it in the “Icône” layer of the Photoshop kit (group “4 · Icône”). With no drawing, the automatic icon is used.
tabAlt_dark: Icon at actual size (16 pixels), dark tab
tabAlt_light: Icon at actual size (16 pixels), light tab
tabCaption_dark: Dark tab · actual size and enlarged
tabCaption_light: Light tab · actual size and enlarged
saved: Icon saved · visible across the whole site
howHelp: The small image next to the site name in the browser tab, and on a phone's home screen.
imageHelp: A square image gives the best result. Otherwise, you choose the part to keep.
lettersEmpty: Empty: the initials of your name.
previewTitle: This is how the icon will look (with the live theme)
phoneAlt: Icon on a phone's home screen
logoTooWide: Your logo is too wide for such a small icon: the monogram is used instead.
